items.text: In 2005, archaeologist Julia Mayo and her team began to (a) ___ a cemetery in Panama. The cemetery was more than 1000 years old. Many (b) ___ were found at this (c) ___. In 2010, she and her team uncovered a powerful warrior (d) ___ wearing (e) ___.

tasks.instruction: READ THE INTRODUCTION THEN READ THE STATEMENTS BELOW. CIRCLE T FOR TRUE OR F FOR FALSE.

items.text: She grew up in the city.
She wants to go to the college.

lead.text:
Ella-Li Spik is a Sami. The Sami is a small group of people who live in Sweden. They herd reindeer. Ella-Li grew up herding reindeer. But things are changing for the Sami. Ella-Li is part of a new generation that wants to attend college.

“I want to explore the world,” she says, “but I always want reindeer to be part of my life.”
